mechanism.mechanism: Closed-loop, sensor-guided two-phase spray cooling where spray parameters (droplet size, flow rate, duty cycle) are modulated in real time by a physics-informed neural network (PINN) that reconstructs local heat flux and thermal stress from distributed fiber-optic strain/temperature measurements, creating a self-verifying causal loop.
mechanism.intervention: Replace the static spray module with an array of piezoelectric micro-spray nozzles, each paired with a fiber Bragg grating
